title: Invariance moments of a product coordinate
statement: Let $I$ be a finite set, and for each $i\in I$ let $(A_i,\mu_i)$ be a probability space. Suppose each function $X_i\colon A_i\to\mathbb R$ is measurable and satisfies the invariance moment conditions under $\mu_i$. Then, for every chosen coordinate $i\in I$, the function on $\prod_{j\in I}A_j$ given by $x\mapsto X_i(x_i)$ satisfies the invariance moment conditions under the product measure $\bigotimes_{j\in I}\mu_j$.
hypotheses_covered: A measurable space $A_i$ and measure $\mu_i$ for each $i\in I$
